summary: Extended RouterResult with raw_llm_response field, created AppraisalAuditLog/AppraisalAuditEntry models, wired audit entry collection into simulate_day_bridged with a backward-compatible DaySimulationResult container, and wrote 11 tests covering all required scenarios.
